criteria.acceptance: Over a fixed number of colony ticks, at least one resource is produced from a source and another is consumed by a building/caste, and a gametest asserts the stockpile deltas (rise and fall), not just that the numbers are non-zero.
criteria.lastVerdict: open: economy tick depth not yet proven by a delta-asserting gametest
criteria.nextAction: Implement/verify a deterministic resource tick (produce + consume) and a gametest asserting stockpile deltas over N ticks.

criteria.acceptance: Each active caste has a job loop (gather/build/patrol/tend) that measurably changes colony state, proven by a gametest that runs the loop and asserts the resulting resource/construction/defense change.
criteria.lastVerdict: open: caste behaviors not yet proven to change colony state end to end
criteria.nextAction: Pick one caste, wire its job loop to a state change, and assert it in a gametest.

criteria.acceptance: A colony with sufficient resources advances from one development stage to the next over ticks without player input, unlocking at least one new building/caste/recipe, proven by a gametest.
criteria.lastVerdict: open: time-based autonomous progression not yet proven
criteria.nextAction: Define stage thresholds and a tick that advances the stage; assert the advance and one unlock in a gametest.

criteria.acceptance: Spending knowledge on a research node (with prerequisites) unlocks a caste, block, recipe, or diplomacy option that has a real mechanical effect, proven by a gametest that researches the node and asserts the unlocked effect is now available.
criteria.lastVerdict: open: research nodes must produce real unlock effects, not just UI state
criteria.nextAction: Wire one research node to a concrete unlock effect and assert it in a gametest.

criteria.acceptance: A trade caravan/market exchange moves resources between two colonies at a rate that depends on scarcity or relation, proven by a gametest asserting both colonies' resource deltas after the exchange.
criteria.lastVerdict: open: trade must move resources with scarcity/relation-based rates
criteria.nextAction: Implement a resource exchange with a scarcity/relation rate and assert both-side deltas in a gametest.

criteria.acceptance: A diplomatic action (tribute, raid, broken contract, shared enemy) shifts a relation (ally/neutral/rival) and that shift changes a mechanical outcome (trade rate, raid risk, joint defense), proven by a gametest.
criteria.lastVerdict: open: relation changes must have mechanical consequences
criteria.nextAction: Wire one action to a relation change with a mechanical effect and assert both in a gametest.

criteria.acceptance: At least one native Formic block has a gameplay role (brood/fungus/resin/storage/defense), is obtainable and placeable in normal play, and participates in the colony tick, proven by a gametest.
criteria.lastVerdict: open: native blocks need real gameplay roles, not decoration only
criteria.nextAction: Give one native block a gameplay role wired into the tick and assert its effect in a gametest.

criteria.acceptance: A soldier caste uses an ant-themed weapon/armor with real combat stats (damage/defense) in a raid or defense, proven by a gametest asserting the combat outcome differs with vs without the weapon.
criteria.lastVerdict: open: weapons need real combat stats used by soldier castes
criteria.nextAction: Add one weapon with combat stats used by soldiers and assert its effect in a combat gametest.

criteria.acceptance: A raid (attack or defense) resolves with casualties and an outcome that changes colony state (resources lost/defended, relation change), proven by a gametest.
criteria.lastVerdict: open: raids must resolve with state-changing outcomes
criteria.nextAction: Resolve one raid with casualties and a state change; assert the outcome in a gametest.
